resources.string: Allows PhoneAgent to perform verified tap and scroll gestures inside Chrome when triggered by the local ADB-forwarded host controller on 127.0.0.1. No screen text or personal data is collected or transmitted off-device.

PhoneAgent uses Android AccessibilityService gesture dispatch (dispatchGesture) to execute tap and scroll actions in Chrome solely from local ADB-forwarded commands on 127.0.0.1. Enable PhoneAgent Gesture Controller in System Accessibility Settings to allow gesture execution.
Keeps the localhost ADB-forwarded WebSocket gesture server active while running sessions.
Listening on 127.0.0.1:8765 via ADB port forwarding for verified UI gestures.
